pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped, stellate polygonal regions with jagged, high-frequency edge gradients. Dark brown centers transition to lighter tan at the margins. Patch size is largest on the upper neck and decreases towards the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of cream-colored interstitial pathways. High density of junction nodes due to the complex, protruding geometry of the patches. Pixel thickness is variable, narrowing between patch points and widening at intersections.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A fuzzy, low-contrast brown silhouette along the superior neck margin. Individual jagged serrations are detectable as a continuous blurred texture rather than distinct hair-level geometry.
